premise: Surya is an unemployed engineering graduate navigating middle-class parental expectations, job hunting struggles, romance with his college junior Anjali, and everyday comedic misadventures with his loyal group of friends.

nicknames.name: V Arjun
nicknames.note: His friends merge 'V' and 'Arjun' into 'Virgin' to tease him.

nicknames.name: Subbu
nicknames.note: Teased for constantly sleeping and prepping for aptitude tests.

nicknames.name: Anjali
nicknames.note: Surya's college junior and romantic partner.

running_bits: Unemployed engineers considering getting a job as the only real festival worth celebrating.
Swami dreading the cash counter at his father's kirana shop after online payments arrived.
Shankaranna the paan shop owner steadily accumulating wealth and building upper floors while engineering graduates remain broke.
Job as the only real festival for unemployed engineers.
Swami despising sitting at the kirana cash counter due to digital payments.
Paan shop owner Shankaranna flourishing financially while engineering graduates remain broke.
catchphrases: మనది కానీ ఒక్క రూపాయి కూడా మనకొద్దు
I love you mummy / I love you daddy / I love my family
relationships: Surya and Meghana: Sibling pair who constantly banter, though Meghana secretly saves pocket money to buy his birthday cake.
Surya and Father / Mother: Caring middle-class parents anxious about his unemployment, while Surya takes money from mother to avoid father's accountability.
Surya and Anjali: Romantic relationship between college senior and junior; Anjali gets an IT job offer in Hyderabad before Surya.
Surya, Swami, Siva, Arjun, and Subbu: Group of unemployed engineering friends who spend their days hanging out at their regular spot termed 'office'.
Surya and Meghana: Sibling banter where Meghana teases Surya but saves money to celebrate his birthday.
Surya and Parents: Mother shields Surya while Father worries about his 3-year post-engineering unemployment.
Surya and Anjali: Romantic bond; Anjali secures a Hyderabad placement before Surya.
Surya and Friend Circle (Swami, Siva, Arjun, Subbu): B.Tech batchmates hanging out daily at their designated 'office'.
